title: Arkret CBA Proof Bundle
description: Unsigned receiver-relative dependency container for exactly one target_seal_ref. Every embedded object MUST belong to the target Realm, be reachable from the target Seal dependency graph, appear in canonical id/digest bytewise order without duplicates, and be independently verified; the bundle itself is not authoritative. A bounded verifiable superset is allowed, but unrelated objects are a schema violation. inclusion_proofs and availability_proofs together MUST contain no more than 2048 items; this cross-property aggregate and the dependency path depth limit of 4096 are semantic validation rules in addition to each array's local JSON Schema bound.

control_moves.description: Control Move Event envelopes only. Semantic validation MUST reject DataEvent, Anchor Unit, actor-private, or unknown non-control Event shapes even when the generic Event Envelope schema is otherwise valid.

inclusion_proofs.description: Inclusion proofs. The combined item count of this array and availability_proofs MUST be no greater than 2048.

availability_proofs.description: Availability proofs. The combined item count of this array and inclusion_proofs MUST be no greater than 2048.
